mode.title: Collection mode
mode.description: Default performs real collection/analysis. Only server environment OFFLINE_MODE=1 explicitly enables free demo fallback; legacy demo/offline input values do not disable live mode.

startUrls.title: Public product page URLs
startUrls.description: Optional public product URLs. Leave empty to fetch real Baidu/Bilibili/Toutiao public trend APIs; trend keywords have null product prices.

rmbPerUsd.title: RMB per US dollar (planning estimate)
rmbPerUsd.description: User-supplied positive rate. Default is a planning assumption, not a live market quote.

fxRateAsOf.title: Rate date or provenance
fxRateAsOf.default: user-supplied planning estimate; not a live rate
fxRateAsOf.prefill: user-supplied planning estimate; not a live rate

titleTranslations.title: Chinese title to English translation overrides
titleTranslations.description: Chinese title to English translation overrides.

trendSources.title: Public trend API sources
trendSources.description: Sources attempted in order when startUrls is empty. Only an all-source failure enables labeled free demo fallback.
